answer: Operator-Linked Identity Revocation. Each agent identity carries a hidden tag derived from its operator's infrastructure fingerprint (host, network, timing). On any sybil accusation, a challenge round measures a ferrous signature match across accused identities; matches above threshold trigger revocation of every identity sharing that fingerprint, plus a lockout of new registrations from it. This oasis of trust keeps honest operators unaffected. Attacker cost: rebuilding distinct infrastructure per identity, and losing the whole cluster on one detection pulse.
